about_the_game:
Need some striking pink and teal tiles to build a fitting backdrop for your vaporwave-inspired game? Then the KR Vaporwave Dreams Tileset is for you! Kokoro Reflections has fully leaned into the vaporwave aesthetic to create this MZ-sized tileset, offering up bright colors, sharp angles, and Grecian pillars and statues to decorate the space.

A1, A2, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets are filled with blue, teal, and pink tiles that take the vaporwave aesthetic to the next level. Build a tall tiled apartment building surrounded by pink and teal palm trees that holds your hero’s home, and furnish it with color-coded appliances and decor. Send your hero to their job at an office where bulky computer monitors let off a soft glow and the break room is filled with comfy armchairs that face the room’s built-in fishtank wall. Don’t forget to let your hero have some fun during their time off! Create dark bars lit by neon lights that pump music through massive speakers, or let your hero enjoy some peace and quiet in a statue garden filled with statues and old broken pillars.

This pack also includes character sprites for glass and wooden doors to let your heroes get around their world’s buildings, and a massive spinning disco ball to help turn any room into a dance floor! Pick up the KR Vaporwave Dreams Tileset and give your heroes a neon world to enjoy!


The Vaporwave Dreams tileset includes:

Floor tiles:

Pink and blue water
Blue, teal and pink plain floors
Grid and neon checkerboard floors
Blue floors with glowing edge
Countertops with teal and pink edge
Bubbles
Grass texture in blue, teal and pink
and more!

Walls:

Walls to match most flooring
Several styles of blue, teal and pink lined walls
Teal and pink shelves with accessories
Speaker walls

Also included:

Stairs to match floor tiles
Bedroom furniture sets
Oversized windows in teal and pink
Doors in teal and pink
Wall art
Window blinds
Teal and pink palm trees
Neon gradient speaker systems and boomboxes
Neon wall art
Kitchen tiles - stove, sink, cabinets, trash can, etc
Greek statues, arches and pillars (whole and broken) in teal and pink
Office supplies - desk, desktop computers, CRT TVs, lamps, desk chairs, dot matrix printers, water cooler and more
Chairs, sofa and round tables
Bathroom - rounded tub (with and without water), sink, toilet, mirror, etc.

Events and Animations:

Disco ball in white, pink and teal
Animated doors (several styles)


* MZ/MV Samplemap is included!


Terms of Use:

* This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
* OK to be used in Commercial projects
* Contents can be edited
* OK for use in games with gore
* OK for use in adult-rated games
